questions.Description: Write a complete script for a short film (2-3 minutes in length). The film should have a clear narrative, defined characters, and a distinct visual style. Include scene descriptions, dialogue, and basic camera directions.
Create a storyboard for a short comic story (4-6 panels). The storyboard should visually depict the story's progression, including character actions, expressions, and panel compositions.

Write a script for a film review (2-3 minutes in length). The review should analyze the film's plot, characters, cinematography, and overall effectiveness. Support your opinions with specific examples from the film.
Given a specific situation (e.g., a chance encounter in a coffee shop, a tense negotiation), write a short script and create a corresponding story board that visually represents the scene.

Write a detailed screenplay scene (2-3 pages) that includes character actions, dialogue, setting descriptions, and camera directions. Focus on creating a compelling scene with a clear dramatic purpose.
Adapt a short story or poem into a short film script. Maintain the essence of the original work while translating it into a cinematic format.
Create a storyboard for a short action sequence (e.g., a chase, a fight). Focus on conveying the action's pacing and intensity through visual composition and panel transitions.
Write a script for a scene that relies heavily on dialogue to develop character relationships and advance the plot. Focus on creating natural and engaging dialogue
Create a storyboard for a short story that is told entirely through visual means, without any dialogue or text.
Given a short film script and storyboard, analyze how the visuals and dialogue work together to tell the story. Identify strengths and weaknesses in the script and storyboard.

Create a short pitch presentation (2-3 minutes) for a proposed short film or web series idea. The pitch should include a logline, brief character descriptions, a summary of the plot, and a description of the target audience and visual style. You may use visual aids (images, concept art) to enhance your presentation.
